findings.asked: Vertical motion: a time, then motion to a point below the start.
findings.wentWrong: A minority used +10 for the acceleration going up; many set s = 25 wrongly in (ii). Successful candidates found the maximum height first and then the new displacement.
findings.rule: Take up as positive, a = -10, and be careful about the sign of s for points below the start.

findings.wentWrong: U + 30 rewritten as 30U; bracket expansion errors; weaker candidates assumed the middle point was halfway and used s = 100; wrong equations of motion despite the formula sheet.
findings.rule: Read the distances from the diagram; do not assume a midpoint.

ruleToRemember: Fix a positive direction and keep signs consistent (a = -10 when up is positive); take displacements from the diagram, not from assumptions; copy the formula from the sheet exactly.
